streams.title: New characters
streams.summary: Nobuyuki Sanada is the first new character and is playable in testing. More than 90 others are on the wishlist.
streams.activity: Rebuilding Nobuyuki's moveset so it plays like Samurai Warriors 4.
streams.description: Characters from other Warriors games, added as new playable characters. Nobuyuki Sanada is the first and is playable in testing. The rest of the list is a wishlist, so the overall figure stays low until more characters are started.

substreams.title: Nobuyuki Sanada
substreams.summary: Playable in testing with his Samurai Warriors 4 model, moves, cloth physics and all six weapons.
substreams.activity: Rebuilding his moveset so it plays like Samurai Warriors 4.
substreams.description: Nobuyuki is ported from Samurai Warriors 4. He has his own Samurai 4 tab on Character Select, cloth physics on his coat and ponytail, and all six weapons, including a sakura Mythic weapon and a black and crimson X weapon. The weapons have their proper names, and the lower blade only comes out on the attacks that use it. His moveset is being rebuilt to match Samurai Warriors 4: the full 8-hit normal string, charge attacks, Hyper attacks, jump attacks, Mighty Strike and the musou camera now work in testing. Still to come: his own character slot, his Gallery entry and a second outfit.

streams.title: Improved graphics
streams.summary: Smoother edges, stronger light shafts and sharper shadows work in game.
streams.activity: Sharper textures and quality presets are next.
streams.description: The mod uses its own graphics add-on. Smoother edges, stronger light shafts, sharper shadows and shadows from stage scenery work in game. Next are sharper textures, less colour banding and quality presets.

streams.title: Menu improvements
streams.summary: Many menus have been rescaled, and there are Xbox, PlayStation 5 and Switch 2 button prompts.
streams.description: Menus across the game have been rescaled to fit modern screens, most recently the Gallery. Button prompts for Xbox, PlayStation 5 and Switch 2 controllers have been added.

screenshots.alt: The Battle Preparations menu with its updated layout
screenshots.caption: The reworked Battle Preparations menu.

streams.title: Larger battles
streams.summary: Battles can hold up to 250 characters instead of 180, and soldiers no longer pop in at the edge of the screen.
streams.activity: Larger battles of up to 250 characters are ready to try.
streams.description: The game normally limits a battle to 180 characters, so soldiers disappear and reappear as others spawn. The limit is now 250, and a test battle reached 241. Characters are also drawn further away.

streams.title: Named officers become new characters
streams.summary: Named officers in battle, such as Nobuyuki Sanada, will appear as the new characters with their own model and moves.
streams.activity: Looking at how named officers are set up in the game data.
streams.description: Many stages have named officers who aren't playable, such as Nobuyuki Sanada. The plan is for them to appear as the new playable characters instead, with their own model and moveset. The game already does this for a few characters. This comes after the new character slots, since each new character needs a slot of their own first.
